Start here

Choose five heroes. Begin at Omatqan, follow the clues to the antique dealer, then reach Harelport. The current Runeterra system rules take priority over the original one-shot. This is a minimal translation example; unlisted content stays French.

tom.name: Tom, the talking watch
tom.description: A talking Yordle pocket watch that cannot tell the time. It warns visitors about Malek and wants to find Brik and Brak.
